neighbours.label: The words 'bit', 'long' and 'falling' completing a short technical or descriptive phrase ('a parity bit is a bit', 'a falling edge', 'grew them long')
fire: A parity bit is a bit that is added to a group of source bits to catch errors.
The memory cycle starts with the row address on the inputs and a falling edge of the strobe line.
The binary bit signals obtained from the clock are fed into the encoder one at a time.
In those years the men trimmed their beards and grew them long, and some wore goatees.
Monks were told to cut the hair in their noses if it got too long.
The counter advances on every falling edge of the clock, and the last bit is latched.
A single bit flips when the signal is falling, and the log records the change.
Her hair had grown too long again, so she tied it back before the long shift began.
quiet: A checksum is a number that is added to a group of source files to catch errors.
The memory cycle starts with the row address on the inputs and a rising pulse on the strobe line.
The coded signals obtained from the clock are fed into the encoder one at a time.
In those years the men trimmed their beards and kept them neat, and some wore goatees.
Monks were told to cut the hair in their noses if it got in the way.
The counter advances on every pulse of the clock, and the last value is latched.
A single switch flips when the signal changes, and the log records the event.
Her hair had grown thick again, so she tied it back before the early shift began.
